import sys

def allocate_and_copy():
    # Allocate 1024 bytes of memory for buf
    buf = bytearray(1024)
    
    # Read up to 100 characters from stdin and copy to buf
    input_data = sys.stdin.read(100)
    buf[:len(input_data)] = input_data.encode('utf-8')
    
    # Allocate another 1024 bytes of memory for buf1
    buf1 = bytearray(1024)
    
    # Read up to 100 characters from stdin and copy to buf1
    input_data2 = sys.stdin.read(100)
    buf1[:len(input_data2)] = input_data2.encode('utf-8')
    
    # Return both buffers
    return buf, buf1

# Call the function
buffer1, buffer2 = allocate_and_copy()

# Print the data stored in both buffers
print("Buffer 1:", buffer1.decode('utf-8', errors='ignore'))
print("Buffer 2:", buffer2.decode('utf-8', errors='ignore'))

def read_input():
    # 1024バイトのメモリを割り当て、アドレスをbufに格納

buf = ctypes.c_char_p(ctypes.pythonapi.malloc(1024))
if not buf:
    raise MemoryError("Bellek tahsisi başarısız oldu")

# İkinci büyük arabellek tahsisi
buf1 = ctypes.c_char_p(ctypes.pythonapi.malloc(1024))

data = input()[:1024]

# İlk arabelleğe kopyalama
ctypes.memmove(buf, data.encode('utf-8'), len(data))

# İkinci arabelleğe 100 karakter kopyalama
ctypes.memmove(buf1, data.encode('utf-8'), min(100, len(data)))

# Bellek serbest bırakma
ctypes.pythonapi.free(buf)
ctypes.pythonapi.free(buf1)
